documents.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
documents.summary: Two parties share confidential information with each other for a stated purpose.

documents.name: Cloud Service Agreement
documents.summary: A provider sells access to cloud software or a SaaS product on a subscription.

fields.label: Cloud Service
fields.ask: What cloud service or product is the Provider selling?
fields.hint: the cloud service or product being sold

fields.label: Subscription Period
fields.ask: How long is the subscription period? For example, 1 year.
fields.hint: how long each subscription term lasts, such as "1 year"

fields.label: Fees
fields.ask: What are the fees, and how are they paid? For example, $12,000 per year, invoiced annually in advance.
fields.hint: what the Customer pays and how

fields.label: Effective Date
fields.ask: The agreement is set to start today. Keep that, or choose another Effective Date?
fields.hint: the date the agreement starts

fields.label: Order Date
fields.ask: The first order is set to start today as well. Keep that, or choose another Order Date?
fields.hint: the date the first order starts

fields.label: Non-Renewal Notice Date
fields.ask: By when must a party give notice that it will not renew? For example, 30 days before the end of the Subscription Period.
fields.hint: the deadline for giving notice of non-renewal, as a phrase such as "30 days before the end of the Subscription Period"

fields.label: General Cap Amount
fields.ask: What should each party’s total liability be capped at? For example, the fees paid in the 12 months before the claim.
fields.hint: the cap on each party's total liability

fields.label: Governing Law
fields.ask: Which state’s laws should govern the agreement?
fields.hint: whose laws govern, written out in full: "the laws of the State of Delaware" when the user says Delaware

fields.label: Chosen Courts
fields.ask: Which courts should hear disputes? For example, the state or federal courts located in New Castle County, Delaware.
fields.hint: the courts that hear disputes, as a phrase such as "state or federal courts located in New Castle County, Delaware"

fields.label: Technical Support
fields.hint: the support the Provider gives, such as "email support on business days"

fields.label: DPA
fields.hint: the data processing agreement between the parties, if they have one

fields.label: Provider Covered Claims
fields.hint: the third-party claims the Provider indemnifies the Customer against

fields.label: Customer Covered Claims
fields.hint: the third-party claims the Customer indemnifies the Provider against

documents.name: Service Level Agreement
documents.summary: Uptime and support response targets, with service credits, for a cloud service sold under another agreement.

fields.label: Underlying Agreement
fields.ask: Which existing agreement does this SLA attach to? For example, the Cloud Service Agreement between the parties dated March 1, 2026.
fields.hint: the existing agreement this SLA is attached to, with its date if known

fields.label: Subscription Period
fields.ask: What is the subscription period of the cloud service? For example, 1 year.
fields.hint: how long the subscription lasts, such as "1 year"

fields.label: Target Uptime
fields.ask: What uptime is the Provider aiming for each month? For example, 99.9%.
fields.hint: the monthly availability target, such as "99.9%"

fields.label: Uptime Credit
fields.ask: What service credit does the Customer get when uptime falls below the target? For example, 5% of that month’s fees.
fields.hint: the credit for missing the uptime target

fields.label: Target Response Time
fields.hint: how quickly support requests are answered, such as "4 business hours"

fields.label: Support Channel
fields.hint: where support requests are sent, such as an email address

fields.label: Response Time Credit
fields.hint: the credit for missing the response time target

fields.label: Scheduled Downtime
fields.hint: planned maintenance windows that do not count as downtime

documents.name: Data Processing Agreement
documents.summary: How a provider processes personal data on a customer’s behalf, added to an existing agreement between them.

fields.label: Agreement
fields.ask: Which existing agreement does this DPA attach to? For example, the Cloud Service Agreement between the parties dated March 1, 2026.
fields.hint: the existing agreement this DPA supplements, with its date if known

fields.label: Categories of Personal Data
fields.ask: What kinds of personal data will the Provider process? For example, names, email addresses and usage data.
fields.hint: the kinds of personal data processed

fields.label: Categories of Data Subjects
fields.ask: Whose personal data is it? For example, the Customer’s employees and end users.
fields.hint: the people the personal data is about

fields.label: Nature and Purpose of Processing
fields.ask: What will the Provider do with the data, and why? For example, hosting and storing it to provide the service.
fields.hint: what is done with the data and for what purpose

fields.label: Duration of Processing
fields.ask: How long will the processing last? For example, for the term of the Agreement.
fields.hint: how long the data is processed

fields.label: Special Category Data
fields.hint: any sensitive data processed, such as health data

fields.label: Special Category Data Restrictions or Safeguards
fields.hint: restrictions or safeguards for the sensitive data

fields.label: Frequency of Transfer
fields.hint: how often data is transferred, such as "continuous"

fields.label: Approved Subprocessors
fields.hint: the subprocessors the Customer approves, or where the list is published

fields.label: Governing Member State
fields.hint: the EU member state whose law governs the EEA transfer clauses, such as "Ireland"

fields.label: Security Policy
fields.hint: the security standard the Provider is audited against, such as "SOC 2 Type II"

fields.label: Provider Security Contact
fields.hint: who the Customer contacts about security, such as an email address
